release_notes_draft:
Public headline: 'New v2 model family: faster inference, lower-memory quantized variant.'

Highlights:
- v2-small: 20–35% lower latency for short-form generation compared to v1 at equivalent quality.
- v2-quantized: enables 4-bit quantized serving with ~2x cost reduction for embedding-heavy workloads.

Compatibility & migration notes:
- API is compatible with existing generation endpoints; no client changes required for default behavior.
- To opt-in to the quantized runtime, set model parameter 'variant=quantized' in the request.

Known limitations:
- Extremely long context lengths (>16k tokens) currently show degraded coherence in edge prompts; see docs for best practices.

SDK snippet (Python):
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="v2-small", prompt="Hello")
print(resp.text)

Contact: support@redwood.ai
